name: code-review
description: Deep-review a GitHub pull request one file at a time, riskiest changes first, through the GitHub CLI you are already signed in to. Findings stay in a local log on your machine — nothing is ever posted back to the PR.
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: Per-file fan-out
x-meta.help: model — reviews each changed file with its own isolated model call. plan — skips the model and returns a per-file plan your agent can delegate to subagents. static — runs only the built-in diff checks, with no model.

x-meta.label: Concurrent per-file reviews
x-meta.help: How many files are reviewed at once in model fan-out.

x-meta.label: Files per review
x-meta.help: Cap the fan-out to the N heaviest files. The rest still appear in the weight table, named as skipped.

x-meta.label: Model entry
x-meta.help: Which configured model runs the per-file reviews. Empty uses the first chat-capable provider from Settings → Models.

x-meta.label: GitHub CLI Timeout
x-meta.help: Maximum seconds to wait for `gh pr diff` before giving up.
